pages.name: Indian: 2.Nf3 e6 3.c3 b6
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the structure as a route (d4-c3) and developed Bd3 with the e-pawn on e2; overview called a c3 set-up Colle-Zukertort. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Indian: London, 3...c5 4.e3
pages.notes: Plan 2 said ...b6 and ...Ba6 challenge the f4-bishop and proposed a ...b5-b4 minority attack. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Neo-Benoni: 3.c3 e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed Bd3 and castled with the e-pawn on e2. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...b6
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the knight f3-d2-f1-e3 to reach e5. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...c5 4.e3 cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White play on the light squares after giving up the dark-squared bishop; plan 3 called the e- and c-files open; plan 4 proposed a minority attack. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; plan 2 wording fixed; British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...c5 4.e3 h6
pages.notes: Plan 3 called e5 a light square and promised quicker development from Bxf6; plan 4 named Bxf6 and Qxf6 as moves; overview spoke of pins. Rewrote overview and plans 3-4 (reviewer rejection fixed and re-reviewed); British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...h6 4.Bxf6 Qxf6 5.e4 d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed Bd2 or Be3 after White's dark-squared bishop had been exchanged; plan 3 pushed f4 through the f3-knight. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: Classical Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 played ...g5 onto White's bishop. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: Wagner Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured on d4 in a gambit where White does not, and played Re1 before castling. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Marienbad System: Berg Variation
pages.notes: Overview called the Marienbad a White system against the Queen's Indian (it is Black's set-up); plan 2 read e4 as a move. Rewrote overview (reviewer rejection of the carried-over error fixed and re-reviewed) and plans 1-2.
